# Immich API Reference

Immich API

## API Reference

### Immich

Path: `/api.html`
Version: 3.0.0-rc.2

Immich API

#### Operations

##### GET /activities

Summary: List all activities

Returns a list of activities for the selected asset or album. The activities are returned in sorted order, with the oldest activities appearing first.

Parameters:
- `albumId` (query, string, required) - Album ID
- `assetId` (query, string, optional) - Asset ID (if activity is for an asset)
- `level` (query, string, optional)
- `type` (query, string, optional)
- `userId` (query, string, optional) - Filter by user ID

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /activities

Summary: Create an activity

Create a like or a comment for an album, or an asset in an album.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 201

##### GET /activities/statistics

Summary: Retrieve activity statistics

Returns the number of likes and comments for a given album or asset in an album.

Parameters:
- `albumId` (query, string, required) - Album ID
- `assetId` (query, string, optional) - Asset ID (if activity is for an asset)

Responses:
- 200

##### DELETE /activities/{id}

Summary: Delete an activity

Removes a like or comment from a given album or asset in an album.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 204

##### POST /admin/auth/unlink-all

Summary: Unlink all OAuth accounts

Unlinks all OAuth accounts associated with user accounts in the system.

Responses:
- 204

##### GET /admin/database-backups

Summary: List database backups

Get the list of the successful and failed backups

Responses:
- 200

##### DELETE /admin/database-backups

Summary: Delete database backup

Delete a backup by its filename

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /admin/database-backups/start-restore

Summary: Start database backup restore flow

Put Immich into maintenance mode to restore a backup (Immich must not be configured)

Responses:
- 201

##### POST /admin/database-backups/upload

Summary: Upload database backup

Uploads .sql/.sql.gz file to restore backup from

Request body: multipart/form-data

Responses:
- 201

##### GET /admin/database-backups/{filename}

Summary: Download database backup

Downloads the database backup file

Parameters:
- `filename` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /admin/integrity/report

Summary: Get integrity report by type

Get all flagged items by integrity report type

Parameters:
- `cursor` (query, string, optional) - Cursor for pagination
- `limit` (query, integer, optional) - Number of items per page
- `type` (query, string, required)

Responses:
- 200

##### DELETE /admin/integrity/report/{id}

Summary: Delete integrity report item

Delete a given report item and perform corresponding deletion (e.g. trash asset, delete file)

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /admin/integrity/report/{id}/file

Summary: Download flagged file

Download the untracked/broken file if one exists

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /admin/integrity/report/{type}/csv

Summary: Export integrity report by type as CSV

Get all integrity report entries for a given type as a CSV

Parameters:
- `type` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /admin/integrity/summary

Summary: Get integrity report summary

Get a count of the items flagged in each integrity report

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /admin/maintenance

Summary: Set maintenance mode

Put Immich into or take it out of maintenance mode

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 201

##### GET /admin/maintenance/detect-install

Summary: Detect existing install

Collect integrity checks and other heuristics about local data.

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /admin/maintenance/login

Summary: Log into maintenance mode

Login with maintenance token or cookie to receive current information and perform further actions.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 201

##### GET /admin/maintenance/status

Summary: Get maintenance mode status

Fetch information about the currently running maintenance action.

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /admin/notifications

Summary: Create a notification

Create a new notification for a specific user.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 201

##### POST /admin/notifications/templates/{name}

Summary: Render email template

Retrieve a preview of the provided email template.

Parameters:
- `name` (path, string, required)

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /admin/notifications/test-email

Summary: Send test email

Send a test email using the provided SMTP configuration.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /admin/users

Summary: Search users

Search for users.

Parameters:
- `id` (query, string, optional) - User ID filter
- `withDeleted` (query, boolean, optional) - Include deleted users

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /admin/users

Summary: Create a user

Create a new user.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 201

##### GET /admin/users/{id}

Summary: Retrieve a user

Retrieve  a specific user by their ID.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 200

##### PUT /admin/users/{id}

Summary: Update a user

Update an existing user.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### DELETE /admin/users/{id}

Summary: Delete a user

Delete a user.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /admin/users/{id}/calendar-heatmap

Summary: Retrieve calendar heatmap activity

Retrieve activity counts for a specified period, in a calendar heatmap format.

Parameters:
- `from` (query, string, optional) - Start date in UTC
- `id` (path, string, required)
- `to` (query, string, optional) - End date in UTC
- `type` (query, string, optional)

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /admin/users/{id}/preferences

Summary: Retrieve user preferences

Retrieve the preferences of a specific user.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 200

##### PUT /admin/users/{id}/preferences

Summary: Update user preferences

Update the preferences of a specific user.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /admin/users/{id}/restore

Summary: Restore a deleted user

Restore a previously deleted user.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /admin/users/{id}/sessions

Summary: Retrieve user sessions

Retrieve all sessions for a specific user.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /admin/users/{id}/statistics

Summary: Retrieve user statistics

Retrieve asset statistics for a specific user.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)
- `isFavorite` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter by favorite status
- `isTrashed` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter by trash status
- `visibility` (query, string, optional)

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /albums

Summary: List all albums

Retrieve a list of albums available to the authenticated user.

Parameters:
- `assetId` (query, string, optional) - Filter albums containing this asset ID (ignores other parameters)
- `id` (query, string, optional) - Album ID
- `isOwned` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter by ownership: true = only owned, false = only shared-with-me, undefined = no filter
- `isShared` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter by shared status: true = only shared, false = not shared, undefined = no filter
- `name` (query, string, optional) - Album name (exact match)

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /albums

Summary: Create an album

Create a new album. The album can also be created with initial users and assets.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 201

##### PUT /albums/assets

Summary: Add assets to albums

Send a list of asset IDs and album IDs to add each asset to each album.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /albums/statistics

Summary: Retrieve album statistics

Returns statistics about the albums available to the authenticated user.

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /albums/{id}

Summary: Retrieve an album

Retrieve information about a specific album by its ID.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)
- `key` (query, string, optional)
- `slug` (query, string, optional)

Responses:
- 200

##### DELETE /albums/{id}

Summary: Delete an album

Delete a specific album by its ID. Note the album is initially trashed and then immediately scheduled for deletion, but relies on a background job to complete the process.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 204

##### PATCH /albums/{id}

Summary: Update an album

Update the information of a specific album by its ID. This endpoint can be used to update the album name, description, sort order, etc. However, it is not used to add or remove assets or users from the album.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### PUT /albums/{id}/assets

Summary: Add assets to an album

Add multiple assets to a specific album by its ID.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### DELETE /albums/{id}/assets

Summary: Remove assets from an album

Remove multiple assets from a specific album by its ID.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /albums/{id}/map-markers

Summary: Retrieve album map markers

Retrieve map marker information for a specific album by its ID.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)
- `key` (query, string, optional)
- `slug` (query, string, optional)

Responses:
- 200

##### PUT /albums/{id}/user/{userId}

Summary: Update user role

Change the role for a specific user in a specific album.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)
- `userId` (path, string, required)

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 204

##### DELETE /albums/{id}/user/{userId}

Summary: Remove user from album

Remove a user from an album. Use an ID of "me" to leave a shared album.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)
- `userId` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 204

##### PUT /albums/{id}/users

Summary: Share album with users

Share an album with multiple users. Each user can be given a specific role in the album.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /api-keys

Summary: List all API keys

Retrieve all API keys of the current user.

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /api-keys

Summary: Create an API key

Creates a new API key. It will be limited to the permissions specified.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 201

##### GET /api-keys/me

Summary: Retrieve the current API key

Retrieve the API key that is used to access this endpoint.

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /api-keys/{id}

Summary: Retrieve an API key

Retrieve an API key by its ID. The current user must own this API key.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 200

##### PUT /api-keys/{id}

Summary: Update an API key

Updates the name and permissions of an API key by its ID. The current user must own this API key.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### DELETE /api-keys/{id}

Summary: Delete an API key

Deletes an API key identified by its ID. The current user must own this API key.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 204

##### POST /assets

Summary: Upload asset

Uploads a new asset to the server.

Parameters:
- `key` (query, string, optional)
- `slug` (query, string, optional)
- `x-immich-checksum` (header, string, optional) - sha1 checksum that can be used for duplicate detection before the file is uploaded

Request body: multipart/form-data

Responses:
- 200: Asset is a duplicate
- 201: Asset uploaded successfully

##### PUT /assets

Summary: Update assets

Updates multiple assets at the same time.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 204

##### DELETE /assets

Summary: Delete assets

Deletes multiple assets at the same time.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 204

##### POST /assets/bulk-upload-check

Summary: Check bulk upload

Determine which assets have already been uploaded to the server based on their SHA1 checksums.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### PUT /assets/copy

Summary: Copy asset

Copy asset information like albums, tags, etc. from one asset to another.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 204

##### POST /assets/jobs

Summary: Run an asset job

Run a specific job on a set of assets.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 204

##### PUT /assets/metadata

Summary: Upsert asset metadata

Upsert metadata key-value pairs for multiple assets.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### DELETE /assets/metadata

Summary: Delete asset metadata

Delete metadata key-value pairs for multiple assets.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 204

##### GET /assets/statistics

Summary: Get asset statistics

Retrieve various statistics about the assets owned by the authenticated user.

Parameters:
- `isFavorite` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter by favorite status
- `isTrashed` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter by trash status
- `visibility` (query, string, optional)

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /assets/{id}

Summary: Retrieve an asset

Retrieve detailed information about a specific asset.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)
- `key` (query, string, optional)
- `slug` (query, string, optional)

Responses:
- 200

##### PUT /assets/{id}

Summary: Update an asset

Update information of a specific asset.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /assets/{id}/edits

Summary: Retrieve edits for an existing asset

Retrieve a series of edit actions (crop, rotate, mirror) associated with the specified asset.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 200

##### PUT /assets/{id}/edits

Summary: Apply edits to an existing asset

Apply a series of edit actions (crop, rotate, mirror) to the specified asset.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### DELETE /assets/{id}/edits

Summary: Remove edits from an existing asset

Removes all edit actions (crop, rotate, mirror) associated with the specified asset.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 204

##### GET /assets/{id}/metadata

Summary: Get asset metadata

Retrieve all metadata key-value pairs associated with the specified asset.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 200

##### PUT /assets/{id}/metadata

Summary: Update asset metadata

Update or add metadata key-value pairs for the specified asset.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /assets/{id}/metadata/{key}

Summary: Retrieve asset metadata by key

Retrieve the value of a specific metadata key associated with the specified asset.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required) - Asset ID
- `key` (path, string, required) - Metadata key

Responses:
- 200

##### DELETE /assets/{id}/metadata/{key}

Summary: Delete asset metadata by key

Delete a specific metadata key-value pair associated with the specified asset.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required) - Asset ID
- `key` (path, string, required) - Metadata key

Responses:
- 204

##### GET /assets/{id}/ocr

Summary: Retrieve asset OCR data

Retrieve all OCR (Optical Character Recognition) data associated with the specified asset.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /assets/{id}/original

Summary: Download original asset

Downloads the original file of the specified asset.

Parameters:
- `edited` (query, boolean, optional) - Return edited asset if available
- `id` (path, string, required)
- `key` (query, string, optional)
- `slug` (query, string, optional)

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /assets/{id}/thumbnail

Summary: View asset thumbnail

Retrieve the thumbnail image for the specified asset. Viewing the fullsize thumbnail might redirect to downloadAsset, which requires a different permission.

Parameters:
- `edited` (query, boolean, optional) - Return edited asset if available
- `id` (path, string, required)
- `key` (query, string, optional)
- `size` (query, string, optional)
- `slug` (query, string, optional)

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /assets/{id}/video/playback

Summary: Play asset video

Streams the video file for the specified asset. This endpoint also supports byte range requests.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)
- `key` (query, string, optional)
- `slug` (query, string, optional)

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /assets/{id}/video/stream/main.m3u8

Summary: Get HLS main playlist

Returns an HLS main playlist with all available variants for the asset.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)
- `key` (query, string, optional)
- `slug` (query, string, optional)

Responses:
- 200

##### DELETE /assets/{id}/video/stream/{sessionId}

Summary: End HLS streaming session

Releases server resources for the streaming session.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)
- `key` (query, string, optional)
- `sessionId` (path, string, required)
- `slug` (query, string, optional)

Responses:
- 204

##### GET /assets/{id}/video/stream/{sessionId}/{variantIndex}/playlist.m3u8

Summary: Get HLS media playlist

Returns an HLS media playlist for one variant of the streaming session.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)
- `key` (query, string, optional)
- `sessionId` (path, string, required)
- `slug` (query, string, optional)
- `variantIndex` (path, integer, required)
- `x-immich-hls-pos` (header, number, optional)

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /assets/{id}/video/stream/{sessionId}/{variantIndex}/{filename}

Summary: Get HLS segment or init file

Streams an HLS init segment (init.mp4) or media segment (seg_N.m4s).

Parameters:
- `filename` (path, string, required)
- `id` (path, string, required)
- `key` (query, string, optional)
- `sessionId` (path, string, required)
- `slug` (query, string, optional)
- `variantIndex` (path, integer, required)
- `x-immich-hls-msn` (header, integer, optional)

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /auth/admin-sign-up

Summary: Register admin

Create the first admin user in the system.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 201

##### POST /auth/change-password

Summary: Change password

Change the password of the current user.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /auth/login

Summary: Login

Login with username and password and receive a session token.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 201

##### POST /auth/logout

Summary: Logout

Logout the current user and invalidate the session token.

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /auth/pin-code

Summary: Setup pin code

Setup a new pin code for the current user.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 204

##### PUT /auth/pin-code

Summary: Change pin code

Change the pin code for the current user.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 204

##### DELETE /auth/pin-code

Summary: Reset pin code

Reset the pin code for the current user by providing the account password

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 204

##### POST /auth/session/lock

Summary: Lock auth session

Remove elevated access to locked assets from the current session.

Responses:
- 204

##### POST /auth/session/unlock

Summary: Unlock auth session

Temporarily grant the session elevated access to locked assets by providing the correct PIN code.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 204

##### GET /auth/status

Summary: Retrieve auth status

Get information about the current session, including whether the user has a password, and if the session can access locked assets.

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /auth/validateToken

Summary: Validate access token

Validate the current authorization method is still valid.

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /download/archive

Summary: Download asset archive

Download a ZIP archive containing the specified assets. The assets must have been previously requested via the "getDownloadInfo" endpoint.

Parameters:
- `key` (query, string, optional)
- `slug` (query, string, optional)

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /download/info

Summary: Retrieve download information

Retrieve information about how to request a download for the specified assets or album. The response includes groups of assets that can be downloaded together.

Parameters:
- `key` (query, string, optional)
- `slug` (query, string, optional)

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 201

##### GET /duplicates

Summary: Retrieve duplicates

Retrieve a list of duplicate assets available to the authenticated user.

Responses:
- 200

##### DELETE /duplicates

Summary: Delete duplicates

Delete multiple duplicate assets specified by their IDs.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 204

##### POST /duplicates/resolve

Summary: Resolve duplicate groups

Resolve duplicate groups by synchronizing metadata across assets and deleting/trashing duplicates.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### DELETE /duplicates/{id}

Summary: Dismiss a duplicate group

Dismiss a duplicate group by its ID, unlinking all assets in the group without deleting them.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 204

##### GET /faces

Summary: Retrieve faces for asset

Retrieve all faces belonging to an asset.

Parameters:
- `id` (query, string, required) - Face ID

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /faces

Summary: Create a face

Create a new face that has not been discovered by facial recognition. The content of the bounding box is considered a face.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 201

##### PUT /faces/{id}

Summary: Re-assign a face to another person

Re-assign the face provided in the body to the person identified by the id in the path parameter.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### DELETE /faces/{id}

Summary: Delete a face

Delete a face identified by the id. Optionally can be force deleted.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 204

##### GET /jobs

Summary: Retrieve queue counts and status

Retrieve the counts of the current queue, as well as the current status.

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /jobs

Summary: Create a manual job

Run a specific job. Most jobs are queued automatically, but this endpoint allows for manual creation of a handful of jobs, including various cleanup tasks, as well as creating a new database backup.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 204

##### PUT /jobs/{name}

Summary: Run jobs

Queue all assets for a specific job type. Defaults to only queueing assets that have not yet been processed, but the force command can be used to re-process all assets.

Parameters:
- `name` (path, string, required)

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /libraries

Summary: Retrieve libraries

Retrieve a list of external libraries.

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /libraries

Summary: Create a library

Create a new external library.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 201

##### GET /libraries/{id}

Summary: Retrieve a library

Retrieve an external library by its ID.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 200

##### PUT /libraries/{id}

Summary: Update a library

Update an existing external library.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### DELETE /libraries/{id}

Summary: Delete a library

Delete an external library by its ID.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 204

##### POST /libraries/{id}/scan

Summary: Scan a library

Queue a scan for the external library to find and import new assets.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 204

##### GET /libraries/{id}/statistics

Summary: Retrieve library statistics

Retrieve statistics for a specific external library, including number of videos, images, and storage usage.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /libraries/{id}/validate

Summary: Validate library settings

Validate the settings of an external library.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /map/markers

Summary: Retrieve map markers

Retrieve a list of latitude and longitude coordinates for every asset with location data.

Parameters:
- `fileCreatedAfter` (query, string, optional) - Filter assets created after this date
- `fileCreatedBefore` (query, string, optional) - Filter assets created before this date
- `isArchived` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter by archived status
- `isFavorite` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter by favorite status
- `withPartners` (query, boolean, optional) - Include partner assets
- `withSharedAlbums` (query, boolean, optional) - Include shared album assets

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /map/reverse-geocode

Summary: Reverse geocode coordinates

Retrieve location information (e.g., city, country) for given latitude and longitude coordinates.

Parameters:
- `lat` (query, number, required) - Latitude (-90 to 90)
- `lon` (query, number, required) - Longitude (-180 to 180)

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /memories

Summary: Retrieve memories

Retrieve a list of memories. Memories are sorted descending by creation date by default, although they can also be sorted in ascending order, or randomly.

Parameters:
- `for` (query, string, optional) - Filter by date
- `isSaved` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter by saved status
- `isTrashed` (query, boolean, optional) - Include trashed memories
- `order` (query, string, optional)
- `size` (query, integer, optional) - Number of memories to return
- `type` (query, string, optional)

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /memories

Summary: Create a memory

Create a new memory by providing a name, description, and a list of asset IDs to include in the memory.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 201

##### GET /memories/statistics

Summary: Retrieve memories statistics

Retrieve statistics about memories, such as total count and other relevant metrics.

Parameters:
- `for` (query, string, optional) - Filter by date
- `isSaved` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter by saved status
- `isTrashed` (query, boolean, optional) - Include trashed memories
- `order` (query, string, optional)
- `size` (query, integer, optional) - Number of memories to return

##### POST /search/large-assets

Summary: Search large assets

Search for assets that are considered large based on specified criteria.

Parameters:
- `albumIds` (query, array, optional) - Filter by album IDs
- `city` (query, string, optional) - Filter by city name
- `country` (query, string, optional) - Filter by country name
- `createdAfter` (query, string, optional) - Filter by creation date (after)
- `createdBefore` (query, string, optional) - Filter by creation date (before)
- `isEncoded` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter by encoded status
- `isFavorite` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter by favorite status
- `isMotion` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter by motion photo status
- `isNotInAlbum` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter assets not in any album
- `isOffline` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter by offline status
- `lensModel` (query, string, optional) - Filter by lens model
- `libraryId` (query, string, optional) - Library ID to filter by
- `make` (query, string, optional) - Filter by camera make
- `minFileSize` (query, integer, optional) - Minimum file size in bytes
- `model` (query, string, optional) - Filter by camera model
- `ocr` (query, string, optional) - Filter by OCR text content
- `personIds` (query, array, optional) - Filter by person IDs
- `rating` (query, integer, optional) - Filter by rating [1-5], or null for unrated
- `size` (query, integer, optional) - Number of results to return
- `state` (query, string, optional) - Filter by state/province name
- `tagIds` (query, array, optional) - Filter by tag IDs
- `takenAfter` (query, string, optional) - Filter by taken date (after)
- `takenBefore` (query, string, optional) - Filter by taken date (before)
- `trashedAfter` (query, string, optional) - Filter by trash date (after)
- `trashedBefore` (query, string, optional) - Filter by trash date (before)
- `type` (query, string, optional)
- `updatedAfter` (query, string, optional) - Filter by update date (after)
- `updatedBefore` (query, string, optional) - Filter by update date (before)
- `visibility` (query, string, optional)
- `withDeleted` (query, boolean, optional) - Include deleted assets
- `withExif` (query, boolean, optional) - Include EXIF data in response

Responses:
- 200

- 200

##### GET /timeline/bucket

Summary: Get time bucket

Retrieve a string of all asset ids in a given time bucket.

Parameters:
- `albumId` (query, string, optional) - Filter assets belonging to a specific album
- `bbox` (query, string, optional) - Bounding box coordinates as west,south,east,north (WGS84)
- `isFavorite` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter by favorite status (true for favorites only, false for non-favorites only)
- `isTrashed` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter by trash status (true for trashed assets only, false for non-trashed only)
- `key` (query, string, optional)
- `order` (query, string, optional) - Sort order for assets within time buckets (ASC for oldest first, DESC for newest first)
- `orderBy` (query, string, optional) - Date to group and order assets by (takenAt for date taken, createdAt for date added to Immich)
- `personId` (query, string, optional) - Filter assets containing a specific person (face recognition)
- `slug` (query, string, optional)
- `tagId` (query, string, optional) - Filter assets with a specific tag
- `timeBucket` (query, string, required) - Time bucket identifier in YYYY-MM-DD format
- `userId` (query, string, optional) - Filter assets by specific user ID
- `visibility` (query, string, optional) - Filter by asset visibility status (ARCHIVE, TIMELINE, HIDDEN, LOCKED)
- `withCoordinates` (query, boolean, optional) - Include location data in the response
- `withPartners` (query, boolean, optional) - Include assets shared by partners
- `withStacked` (query, boolean, optional) - Include stacked assets in the response. When true, only primary assets from stacks are returned.

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /timeline/buckets

Summary: Get time buckets

Retrieve a list of all minimal time buckets.

Parameters:
- `albumId` (query, string, optional) - Filter assets belonging to a specific album
- `bbox` (query, string, optional) - Bounding box coordinates as west,south,east,north (WGS84)
- `isFavorite` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter by favorite status (true for favorites only, false for non-favorites only)
- `isTrashed` (query, boolean, optional) - Filter by trash status (true for trashed assets only, false for non-trashed only)
- `key` (query, string, optional)
- `order` (query, string, optional) - Sort order for assets within time buckets (ASC for oldest first, DESC for newest first)
- `orderBy` (query, string, optional) - Date to group and order assets by (takenAt for date taken, createdAt for date added to Immich)
- `personId` (query, string, optional) - Filter assets containing a specific person (face recognition)
- `slug` (query, string, optional)
- `tagId` (query, string, optional) - Filter assets with a specific tag
- `userId` (query, string, optional) - Filter assets by specific user ID
- `visibility` (query, string, optional) - Filter by asset visibility status (ARCHIVE, TIMELINE, HIDDEN, LOCKED)
- `withCoordinates` (query, boolean, optional) - Include location data in the response
- `withPartners` (query, boolean, optional) - Include assets shared by partners
- `withStacked` (query, boolean, optional) - Include stacked assets in the response. When true, only primary assets from stacks are returned.

Responses:
- 200

- `from` (query, string, optional) - Start date in UTC
- `to` (query, string, optional) - End date in UTC
- `type` (query, string, optional)

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /users/me/license

Summary: Retrieve user product key

Retrieve information about whether the current user has a registered product key.

Responses:
- 200

##### PUT /users/me/license

Summary: Set user product key

Register a product key for the current user.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### DELETE /users/me/license

Summary: Delete user product key

Delete the registered product key for the current user.

Responses:
- 204

##### GET /users/me/onboarding

Summary: Retrieve user onboarding

Retrieve the onboarding status of the current user.

Responses:
- 200

##### PUT /users/me/onboarding

Summary: Update user onboarding

Update the onboarding status of the current user.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### DELETE /users/me/onboarding

Summary: Delete user onboarding

Delete the onboarding status of the current user.

Responses:
- 204

##### GET /users/me/preferences

Summary: Get my preferences

Retrieve the preferences for the current user.

Responses:
- 200

##### PUT /users/me/preferences

Summary: Update my preferences

Update the preferences of the current user.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /users/profile-image

Summary: Create user profile image

Upload and set a new profile image for the current user.

Request body: multipart/form-data

Responses:
- 201

##### DELETE /users/profile-image

Summary: Delete user profile image

Delete the profile image of the current user.

Responses:
- 204

##### GET /users/{id}

Summary: Retrieve a user

Retrieve a specific user by their ID.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /users/{id}/profile-image

Summary: Retrieve user profile image

Retrieve the profile image file for a user.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /view/folder

Summary: Retrieve assets by original path

Retrieve assets that are children of a specific folder.

Parameters:
- `path` (query, string, required)

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /view/folder/unique-paths

Summary: Retrieve unique paths

Retrieve a list of unique folder paths from asset original paths.

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /workflows

Summary: List all workflows

Retrieve a list of workflows available to the authenticated user.

Parameters:
- `description` (query, string, optional) - Workflow description
- `enabled` (query, boolean, optional) - Workflow enabled
- `id` (query, string, optional) - Workflow ID
- `name` (query, string, optional) - Workflow name
- `trigger` (query, string, optional) - Workflow trigger type

Responses:
- 200

##### POST /workflows

Summary: Create a workflow

Create a new workflow, the workflow can also be created with empty filters and actions.

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 201

##### GET /workflows/triggers

Summary: List all workflow triggers

Retrieve a list of all available workflow triggers.

Responses:
- 200

##### GET /workflows/{id}

Summary: Retrieve a workflow

Retrieve information about a specific workflow by its ID.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 200

##### PUT /workflows/{id}

Summary: Update a workflow

Update the information of a specific workflow by its ID. This endpoint can be used to update the workflow name, description, trigger type, filters and actions order, etc.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Request body: application/json

Responses:
- 200

##### DELETE /workflows/{id}

Summary: Delete a workflow

Delete a workflow by its ID.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 204

##### GET /workflows/{id}/share

Summary: Retrieve a workflow

Retrieve a workflow details without ids, default values, etc.

Parameters:
- `id` (path, string, required)

Responses:
- 200
